findings.finding: Single Codex fault pauses unrelated accounts
findings.resolution: Per-agent operation/exposure gates; cohort state retains owner intent.

findings.finding: Malformed completed CLI answer loses known usage
findings.resolution: Completed final usage returned separately from decisionError; ambiguous event streams remain unknown.

findings.finding: Crash leaves filesystem execution lock forever
findings.resolution: Kernel flock ownership, independent 95-second process-tree timeout, bounded cancellation; legacy unverifiable lock explicitly gated.

findings.finding: Worker expiry guesses model usage before dispatch
findings.resolution: Certified dispatch checkpoints distinguish nonexecution, inference uncertainty and original pending commands; conservative adapter fallback.

findings.finding: Read transport/schema failures park agents permanently
findings.resolution: Bounded observation-only retries and next original-slot recovery; canonical object-key schema comparison.

findings.finding: Missing receipt has only manual recovery
findings.resolution: Prospective receipt-only recovery queue with leases and capped backoff; original command never replayed; absence remains unresolved.

findings.finding: Receipt resolution fails to restore readiness
findings.resolution: Eligibility recomputed across credentials, pending/owner turns, operation gates, configuration blockers and explicit agent state.

findings.finding: Refresh crash strands refreshing credential
findings.resolution: Proof-bound result recovery plus atomic encrypted proof/job preparation and completion, per-account singleflight and CAS.

findings.finding: Ambiguous rotating refresh replay revokes family
findings.resolution: Independent 32-byte proof, encrypted bounded result, client/account/grant/child checks, protocol downgrade/expiry gates; legacy replay remains forbidden.

findings.finding: Early access 401 or one reconnect stops whole cohort
findings.resolution: One bounded forced refresh on session initialization auth rejection; same idle-account reconnect allowed while cohort runs; initial enrollment remains complete.

findings.finding: Resume requires all credentials and callback clears unrelated blockers
findings.resolution: Anchored owner resumption permits isolated blocked accounts; callback preserves other blocked turns/configuration and explicit pause.

findings.finding: Low disk looks healthy and disables expiry supervision
findings.resolution: Explicit /ready reason; supervision/recovery independent of new admissions and long turns; actual worker-process test.

findings.finding: Database errors/hangs terminate or wedge workers
findings.resolution: Bounded statement/lock/idle-transaction waits, sanitized pool error handlers, guarded polling and durable restart recovery.

findings.finding: Capacity check after earliest candidate starves other cohorts
findings.resolution: Capacity and blockers checked before candidate LIMIT; original anchored cadence and no catch-up burst.

findings.finding: Budget waits have no durable wake/exposure policy
findings.resolution: Persisted budget/dependency waits; daily UTC boundary; finite Codex unknown-exposure gate; original allocations retained.

findings.finding: Maintenance pause overwrites owner intent
findings.resolution: Leased maintenance hold blocks new admissions, drains naturally, checks quiescence on release/expiry; never clears manual pause.

findings.finding: Optional helper and irreducible input failures
findings.resolution: Existing helper abstention/fallback retained; required memory never erased. Retry state/next action exposed; irreducible protected input or corrupt security/configuration needs repair.

findings.finding: 30-second job lease expires during valid provider call
findings.resolution: Renewable unique per-acquisition ownership, single-flight polling, bounded provider signal and stale-operation checks before tools.

findings.finding: Pre-dispatch failures terminate runs/enrollment
findings.resolution: Known safe failures and no-game-effect orphan phases recover within original call/token/deadline limits; unknown inference/game effects remain scoped gates.

findings.finding: World operational pause persists after health returns
findings.resolution: Future operational-origin pauses require repeated database/tick-history checks then resume from committed time; manual/legacy pauses stay held.

findings.finding: Late acknowledgments and final usage disappear
findings.resolution: Original command receipt reconciliation; late final usage retained as additional evidence without deleting unknown markers or refunding allocation.

findings.finding: Healthy process is mistaken for agent progress
findings.resolution: Separate worker readiness/progress, durable recovery ages/reasons/next checks, authenticated plain-language console; no external notifications created.

findings.finding: Explicit stop/revocation/deadline or terminal population restarted by recovery
findings.resolution: All automatic work remains conditional on current owner intent and fences. Historical decisions are not backfilled/reviewed; terminal cohorts remain terminal.

remainingBoundaries: Existing server50 pause, Agent27 review and Agent17 same-account reconnect are not authorized by deployment.

Unknown actual Codex consumption retains its allocation and requires scoped exposure review; finite shared allowances gate new paid work. Automatic unknown-cost continuation needs an explicit owner policy or enforceable provider ceiling.
A missing submitted-command receipt is not nonexecution proof; reconcile the original ID without replay.
Revoked/expired/legacy ambiguous credentials need same-account owner reauthorization; never reuse an old rotating token blindly.
Unverifiable legacy process locks, wrong keys/configuration and irreducible protected input need repair; never erase history or override authority.
